06e2f6ac30728b2e.description:
We are looking for a high-calibre Assistant Vice President – Strategy to work closely with the CSO and senior leadership team on the organization’s growth agenda, strategic priorities, investor readiness, and cross-functional execution. The ideal candidate will combine strong commercial and financial acumen with exceptional analytical, communication, and practical AI capabilities.

About the Role

A key requirement is proven experience applying AI to live business use cases, with the ability to identify, implement, and measure AI-led improvements beyond basic productivity applications.

Responsibilities
Corporate Strategy & Business Growth 
• Partner with the CSO and leadership team to formulate and execute the company’s strategic agenda, priorities, KPIs, and growth plans.
• Identify new markets, products, partnerships, channels, and business models through market research, competitive intelligence, financial analysis, and emerging technology trends.
• Lead high-priority cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution and measurable outcomes.
AI Strategy & Live AI Use Cases 
• Identify, prioritize, and implement AI/GenAI use cases across functions to drive revenue, productivity, efficiency, automation, and better decision-making.
• Work with internal teams and technology partners to deploy AI-enabled workflows, analytics, automation, decision-support systems, and AI agents.
• Stay current with Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, automation, and enterprise AI and translate relevant developments into practical, ROI-driven applications.
Investor Relations & Fundraising Support 
• Own investor-facing collateral including fundraising decks, information memoranda, business plans, and management presentations.
• Build and maintain financial models, forecasts, valuation analyses, and scenario models.
• Support fundraising, investor discussions, due diligence, and engagement with investors, investment bankers, equity analysts, lenders, and advisors.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights 
• Monitor industry, competitor, technology, and macroeconomic trends and provide actionable insights to leadership.
• Conduct market sizing, competitive benchmarking, opportunity assessment, and business performance analysis.
• Develop executive dashboards, reports, and presentations highlighting key opportunities, risks, KPIs, and performance gaps.
CEO’s Office & Cross-functional Execution 
• Act as a strategic extension of the CEO, driving alignment and execution across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, HR, Technology, and other functions.
• Develop business cases, operating plans, KPIs, and performance reviews with functional leaders.
• Drive accountability, timelines, and measurable outcomes across critical strategic initiatives.
• Independently structure complex problems and present clear, data-driven recommendations to senior leadership.
Corporate Development & Strategic Initiatives 
• Support product-market fit, GTM strategy, market entry, strategic partnerships, M&A evaluation, due diligence, and business transformation initiatives as required.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Management, or related fields; MBA preferred.
• 6–10 years of experience in Corporate Strategy, Management Consulting, Investment Banking, PE/VC, Corporate Development, Strategic Finance, CEO’s Office, or a high-growth company.
• Experience working directly with CXOs/senior leadership; investor-facing or fundraising experience preferred.

Required Skills

AI & Digital Transformation — Mandatory 
• Strong practical proficiency in AI and Generative AI, with hands-on experience implementing live business use cases.
• Ability to explain the problem, AI solution, personal contribution, tools/technology, implementation challenges, and measurable business impact of previous AI initiatives.
• Understanding of LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, AI automation, AI analytics, and workflow transformation.
• Ability to translate AI capabilities into practical, scalable, and ROI-driven business applications.
Strategy, Finance & Communication 
• Strong understanding of corporate strategy, financial modelling, corporate finance, valuation, and business analysis.
• Advanced Excel skills and strong PowerPoint/storytelling capabilities.
• Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with strong executive presence.
• Ability to structure complex problems, manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight timelines.

060cf5bbf3efd649.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.

What you’ll do

You will manage a team of Seller Systems Operations Associates in a player-coach capacity. You’ll be accountable for your team’s operational performance, development, and engagement, while working closely with global operations specialists, business process owners, and cross-functional partners to improve workflows and user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day operational performance of a team of Associates, including quality, productivity, service-level, and other team goals.
  • Set clear expectations, priorities, and performance goals for individuals and the team.
  • Manage team capacity, scheduling, and work allocation to ensure critical workflows are covered and work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Coach Associates on troubleshooting, process knowledge, communication, and sound judgment in resolving user issues.
  • Hold regular development conversations and provide timely, constructive feedback that supports growth and career progression.
  • Complete performance reviews and address performance concerns in partnership with your manager and People team partners, as appropriate.
  • Build a collaborative, inclusive team environment where Associates can raise risks, share ideas, and learn from one another.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex operational or user issues, using sound judgment to resolve issues or route them to the right partner.
  • Partner with global operations specialists and business process owners to run critical Internal Systems workflows.
  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and manual work.
  • Lead or contribute to improvements that increase quality, reduce effort, and improve the user experience.
  • Use operational data and team insights to surface trends, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve product offerings, processes, tools, and user-facing communications.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ramping of new team members.
  • Help build the operating culture, team practices, and capabilities of Stripe Delivery Centers.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience leading, supervising, or formally mentoring an operations, support, or user-facing team.
  • 9+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, operations, or another internal or external user-facing environment.
  • Experience managing operational work against defined quality, productivity, or service-level goals.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback.
  • Experience coaching others and supporting their professional development
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with API integrations, including diagnosing implementation issues, interpreting technical documentation, and guiding teams through ambiguous customer or system problems.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and make practical improvements.
  • The ability to prioritize effectively and make sound decisions in a fast-moving, structured environment.
  • A process-oriented mindset and a track record of improving workflows, reducing manual effort, or improving user experiences.
  • Experience working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • A user-first mindset and interest in learning technical products, systems, and processes.
  • The ability to work from the Bengaluru office in night shift

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience using operational data to manage performance, identify trends, and prioritize improvements.
  • Experience supporting hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, or scheduling for an operations team.
  • Experience working with global teams across time zones.

06ff93fc9483639e.description:
GAQ427R213

This Manager role within Databricks’ Credit & Collections organisation is responsible for driving credit strategy, strategic customer collections, AR performance, and complex escalations across a high-growth, usage-based Data/AI business. The role combines financial and commercial judgment with hands-on customer engagement, functional oversight of collection operations, and governance of the outsourced collections model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a CA, CPA, or experienced finance professional to take ownership of credit risk, cash, strategic customer relationships, and AR performance at Databricks scale. This is an individual contributor position with an expectation to be hands-on. 

The impact you will have:

  • Lead the Credit & Collections function for an assigned scope within Databricks, including credit policies, collection practices, risk mitigation, and escalation protocols
  • Own credit assessment, risk reviews, credit limits, payment terms, credit holds/releases, and exception management within the established approval framework
  • Make credit recommendations and decisions within delegated authority, balancing credit risk, cash conversion, and commercial considerations
  • Personally manage collections strategy and executive-level escalations for strategic and high-value Databricks customers
  • Lead resolution of complex disputes, contractual payment issues, and commercially sensitive collection matters
  • Own the monthly AR performance framework, including collection targets, cash collected vs. target, CEI, ageing, write-offs, and cash forecasting
  • Translate AR and credit trends into actionable insights for Finance leadership, including emerging risks, recovery outlook, and bad debt/reserve considerations
  • Manage the Accenture collections engagement, including SLA/KPI governance, account allocation, quality, process adherence, escalations, and corrective actions
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, Legal, Billing, and Finance leadership to resolve high-impact credit and collection matters
  • Identify systemic drivers of delinquency and credit exposure and lead initiatives to strengthen controls, processes, and collection effectiveness
  • Drive process transformation and continuous improvement across Credit & Collections, leveraging automation, AI, analytics, and scalable operating models to improve efficiency and decision-making
  • Serve as the subject-matter authority for Credit & Collections, providing guidance on complex cases, policies, credit decisions, and commercial considerations

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting is a must; CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • 12+ years of progressive experience across Credit & Collections, ideally within high-growth SaaS, technology, or complex B2B environments
  • Proven experience in credit risk assessment, collections strategy, and managing strategic or high-value customer relationships
  • Strong understanding of usage-based and subscription billing models, commercial contracts, and associated credit risks
  • Demonstrated experience owning AR KPIs, collection targets, CEI, DSO, ageing, cash forecasting, write-offs, and bad debt/reserve analysis
  • Experience operationalising credit policies, approval frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies
  • Experience governing outsourced collections operations against defined SLAs and performance metrics
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate large datasets into clear financial and risk insights
  • Advanced Excel and strong ERP/reporting systems experience; SAP, NetSuite and Salesforce preferred
  • Demonstrated experience driving process transformation, automation, or technology-enabled improvements; practical application of AI in finance or AR operations is a plus
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with customers and senior cross-functional stakeholders
  • This role will require working in PST hours.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.
